chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Tatana narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ziyad al-Nahdi, from Abdullah ibn Salih, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father the Commander of the Believers Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) said: O Ali, whoever loves me, loves you, and loves the Imams from your offspring, let him praise Allah for the goodness of his birth, for indeed, none loves us except the one whose birth is good, and none hates us except the one whose birth is wicked.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of 'good birth' in loving the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* via the prestigious chain of the Ahl al-Bayt, this hadith elucidates the concept of *al-walada al-tayyiba* (pure lineage/nature) as a divine prerequisite for genuine love (*mawadda*) of the Prophet and his Imams. It establishes that spiritual affinity is not merely an intellectual choice but an intrinsic reflection of one's created essence, linking the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt to the purity of their lovers' souls.
